resources.string: Run shell commands in an installed app-internal PRoot Linux selected by Linux ID.
Download or import and manage multiple local Linux environments.
Requires arm64-v8a or x86_64 native runtime support.
Not installed. The rootfs download is about 50 MB.
Installed. Local terminal and debian_command are available.
Disabling Debian only hides its terminal and Agent tool. App updates never replace the configured rootfs; uninstalling or clearing app data still removes it.
Select a compatible tar.gz/tgz or uncompressed tar rootfs containing /bin/sh or /bin/bash. Ubuntu, Alpine, Debian, and other PRoot-compatible distributions can coexist.
This permanently deletes the whole Linux rootfs, including every installed package, user file, and system configuration. This cannot be undone.
Each environment has a stable Linux ID used by the terminal and proot_command. Disabling preserves its data; app updates never overwrite rootfs data.
Supported files: .tar.gz, .tgz, or uncompressed .tar rootfs archives. Choose the device architecture: ARM64 (arm64/aarch64) or x86_64 (amd64). The archive must contain /bin/sh or /bin/bash.
Not supported: ISO installer/live images, APK packages, .tar.xz, and .tar.zst. Decompress XZ/Zstandard archives to .tar before importing.
Choose “Mini root filesystem” → %1$s → .tar.gz, not Standard/Virtual ISO.
Choose a release and download ubuntu-base-…-%1$s.tar.gz.
Choose an ARMv8/AArch64 generic root filesystem tar.gz.
Compatibility reference and examples; ISO images are not PRoot rootfs archives.
Import only %1$s rootfs files. Images for other architectures will not run on this device.
This rootfs uses %1$s, but this device requires %2$s. Download a matching rootfs and select it again. The file was not imported; existing environments are unchanged.
This archive does not contain /bin/sh or /bin/bash. Select a complete Linux rootfs, not an installer ISO, source archive or individual package. Existing environments are unchanged.
The rootfs shell is not a valid Linux executable, or its symbolic link is broken. Download a complete rootfs matching this device and retry. Existing environments are unchanged.

The archive is invalid, damaged, incomplete or contains unsafe paths. Use a complete .tar.gz, .tgz or uncompressed .tar rootfs. Decompress .xz/.zst first; ISO, ZIP and APK files cannot be imported. Existing environments are unchanged.
The selected file cannot be read. Save a local copy and select it again to grant access.
Import could not be completed. Check available storage and file access, then retry.
